description: Timeline X-Ray: deep-verify candidate issues against their GitHub timelines before writing code. Fetches each issue's timeline, classifies every cross-referenced PR with link-strength scoring, and flags reporter-owned fix PRs and comment claims. Returns GO / RISKY / TAKEN per issue with PR evidence (number, state, link strength, URL). List views hide in-flight PRs; run this on scan results first.

from_scan.description: X-ray the scan's top candidates instead of listing issue numbers.

issues.description: Comma-separated issue numbers, e.g. "8149,9319". Omit with from_scan.

name: xray_issues
